hero.title: Adhiyamaan College of Agriculture and Research
hero.summary: ACAR is an AERI Trust agriculture college in Athimugam, Krishnagiri district. Founded in 2016, it offers a four-year B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture under TNAU affiliation. Its official undergraduate page explains the university and management admission routes.

overview.heading: Agricultural study near Hosur
paragraphs: Adhiyamaan College of Agriculture and Research was established by AERI Trust in 2016. The college describes a 122.5-acre setting at Athimugam, around 22 kilometres from Hosur. Its TNAU affiliation provides the academic framework for the undergraduate agriculture programme.

The degree brings together crop improvement, plant protection, agricultural engineering, economics and extension. ACAR also publishes departmental material that helps applicants look beyond the course title: its plant-protection section describes insect specimens, microscopy and applied insect-related learning resources. A campus visit can examine how those resources support practical classes and how laboratory study connects with crop problems.

admissions.heading: Planning an application to ACAR
admissions.intro: ACAR’s UG page asks all applicants to obtain a TNAU rank and describes university and management channels. Treat the published 65:35 split as undated guidance until checked against the intended admission year.

steps.title: Register for the TNAU ranking process
steps.text: ACAR explicitly asks all candidates to register through the TNAU admission website and obtain a rank.

steps.title: Confirm the relevant admission channel
steps.text: Ask ACAR which current seats are offered through university counselling or management and request the applicable eligibility rules.

scholarships.heading: Scholarships and financial support
scholarships.text: ACAR publishes a scholarship-support sheet covering its enrolled cohorts. It names the 7.5% quota, First Graduate, Pudhumai Penn, Tamizh Pudhalvan, SC/ST/SCC and BC/MBC/DNC categories. These are reported support routes, not a promise that every new agriculture applicant qualifies.

schemes.name: Reported state-support and scholarship categories
schemes.details: The institutional sheet lists the named quota/community and state schemes and marks UMIS updates/verification. Request the current scheme notice, award amount and your category-specific documents from the scholarship office; its published nodal contact is office@acar.ac.in.

placements.heading: Career support and outcomes
placements.text: ACAR provides a placements section on its official website, and the facilities directory lists a training and placement cell. A current agriculture cohort report was not verified, so no placement percentage, recruiter list or salary figure is asserted.

faqs.question: Who runs ACAR?
faqs.answer: The official website identifies AERI Trust, Adhiyamaan Educational and Research Institutions, as the organisation running the college.

faqs.question: Where is the campus?
faqs.answer: It is at Athimugam on the Shoolagiri–Berigai Road in Krishnagiri district; the college places it about 22 km from Hosur.

faqs.question: Must applicants register with TNAU?
faqs.answer: The published UG page says all candidates should register through the TNAU admission website and obtain ranking. Confirm current instructions before applying.

faqs.question: Is ACAR a university?
faqs.answer: No. The audited record identifies a private college affiliated to Tamil Nadu Agricultural University.

faqs.question: Until when does the audited ICAR term run?
faqs.answer: The agriculture entry is dated 8 February 2024 to 7 February 2029. Its printed intake is not a live seat-availability statement.

faqs.question: What entry qualification is published for ACAR?
faqs.answer: The official college admission page requires the applicable TNAU eligibility norms. Current subject combinations, category thresholds and equivalence rules were not independently verified.
